description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; each call uses one AI analysis from the licence quota. Builds a negotiation plan for the buyer: the goal, the best alternative if there is no agreement, a recommended opening position, the walk-away point, concessions with what to ask in return, likely supplier objections with answers, an opening sentence and traps to avoid. Uses only the numbers the buyer gives; where a fact is missing it leaves a placeholder. Negotiation guidance from an experienced buyer, not legal advice and no promise of outcome. The input is processed for this answer only and is not stored by KULIC Advisory.

goal.description: Optional: what the buyer wants to reach.

language.description: Language of the answer: de, en, fr, es, pt or zh. Default de.

supplier.description: Optional: type of supplier and relationship, e.g. 'regional manufacturer, supplier for six years'. No need for a real name.

walk_away.description: Optional: the point at which the buyer walks away.

what_is_bought.description: What the negotiation is about, e.g. 'Packaging film, 40 t a year, supplier announces 9 % more from January'.

name: plan_negotiation
title: Prepare a supplier negotiation: goal, alternative, opening position, concessions and answers to objections (AICTIONBOT™ negotiation sparring)
